faq.buy_ticket_q: How do I buy a ticket?
faq.buy_ticket_a: Simply find the event you want to attend, select your ticket category and quantity, click 'Book Ticket', and proceed to checkout. You'll receive your e-ticket via email after successful payment.
faq.payment_methods_q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.payment_methods_a: We accept QRIS and Virtual Accounts.
faq.find_ticket_q: Where can I find my ticket after purchase?
faq.find_ticket_a: You'll receive your ticket via email. You can also access it by logging into your account and visiting the 'My Tickets' section.
faq.print_ticket_q: Do I need to print my ticket?
faq.print_ticket_a: Not necessarily! Most events accept e-tickets. Just show the QR code on your phone at the entrance. If the organizer requires printed tickets, you'll be notified.
faq.refund_q: Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
faq.refund_a: Refund policies vary by event. Please check the event's refund policy before purchasing. If refunds are allowed, you can request one from your ticket dashboard or contact support.
faq.no_email_q: I didn't receive my ticket email—what should I do?
faq.no_email_a: First, check your spam or promotions folder. If it’s not there, log in to your account and go to “My Tickets”. Still can’t find it? Contact our support team.
faq.event_canceled_q: What if the event is canceled or rescheduled?
faq.event_canceled_a: If an event is canceled or rescheduled, we'll notify you via email with further instructions. Refunds or ticket validity for the new date will be subject to the event organizer's policy.
faq.multiple_tickets_q: Can I buy tickets for multiple people in one transaction?
faq.multiple_tickets_a: Yes! Just select the quantity you need during checkout. You'll receive all tickets under one booking, which you can forward or share.
faq.safety_q: Is it safe to buy tickets on your platform?
faq.safety_a: Yes, your personal and payment information is protected with industry-standard encryption. We also work directly with verified event organizers.
faq.contact_support_q: How do I contact customer support?
faq.contact_support_a: You can reach us via email at support@wukong.co.id or through live chat on our website during business hours.

1.title: What is the Event Funding Platform from Wukong x EKUID?
1.desc: Wukong has collaborated with EKUID to provide a next-generation event funding platform that helps professional event organizers obtain capital through structured event crowdfunding and event financing. It empowers organizers to fund, manage, and grow events with confidence, from planning to execution.

2.title: Who Can Apply for Wukong Event Funding?
2.desc: Wukong X EKUID provide event funding designed for professional event organizers, production houses, and non-public companies planning commercial or large-scale events. Each application is reviewed to ensure quality, feasibility, and sustainability.

3.title: How Does Event Crowdfunding Work on Wukong?
3.desc: Our event crowdfunding system enables organizers to secure funding after passing verification and due diligence. Funding is collected transparently and disbursed in stages based on approved milestones, helping events maintain financial health and build contributor trust.

4.title: What Types of Events Can Use Wukong Event Funding?
4.desc:
Wukong supports various event categories, including:
  • Music & Entertainment Events
  • Sports & Running Events
  • Conferences & Exhibitions
  • Community & Creative Events
Each funding proposal is evaluated based on event scale, audience demand, and execution readiness.

5.title: How Much Funding Can Be Obtained Through Event Funding?
5.desc: Wukong provides event financing up to IDR 10 billion, depending on the event profile, funding structure, and due diligence results. This makes Wukong ideal for both growing and large-scale events.

6.title: Why Choose Event Financing Over Traditional Loans?
6.desc: Unlike traditional loans, event financing on Wukong X EKUID reduces upfront financial pressure, improves cash flow, and aligns funding with actual event performance, allowing organizers to focus on delivering exceptional experiences.

7.title: Is Wukong Event Funding Safe and Regulated?
7.desc: Yes. Wukong operates as a licensed and secure event funding platform, adhering to strict compliance, fund control mechanisms, and transparent reporting to protect both organizers and contributors.

8.title: How Long Does the Event Funding Approval Process Take?
8.desc: In accordance with OJK regulations, crowdfunding campaigns run for 45 days, excluding registration, due diligence, and other preliminary steps. However, the process can be faster depending on how compelling the campaign is to investors.

9.title: How Are Event Funds Disbursed to Organizers?
9.desc: Event funds are disbursed in stages based on the approved funding plan and event milestones, ensuring responsible capital usage and smoother event execution.

10.title: Can Event Ticket Sales Be Integrated with Event Funding?
10.desc: Yes. Wukong integrates event ticketing with funding and reporting, providing organizers with real-time insights into ticket performance, funding progress, and overall financial health.

11.title: What Happens If an Event Is Canceled or Rescheduled?
11.desc: If an event is canceled or rescheduled, Wukong follows established event funding risk management and refund mechanisms to ensure fair outcomes for all parties.

12.title: Is Prior Experience Required to Apply for Event Funding?
12.desc: Experience helps but is not mandatory. Wukong evaluates event funding applications based on the quality of planning, team credibility, market demand, and financial feasibility.

13.title: What Documents Are Required for an Event Funding Application?
13.desc:
General requirements include:
  • Company profile
  • Event proposal & budget plan
  • Legal and business documents
  • Relevant supporting materials
These help us tailor the right funding solution for your event.

14.title: How Do I Start Event Funding on Wukong?
14.desc: Simply click “Start Funding”, submit your event and company details, and our team will guide you through the verification and funding process.

15.title: How Can I Contact Wukong for Event Funding Support?
15.desc: Our team is ready to assist. Contact us through the contact form or official channels on the website for prompt and professional support.
